# Rules, skills and decisions

Generated by `chough library index`. These files own how work is done here: agent
instructions, the workflow skill, recorded decisions, each module's decisions and
lessons, and the SDD policy. A lesson that changes behaviour becomes a change to one of
them through a native change.
